tasks.sql:
WITH rpt_contacts AS (
SELECT src.id, src.organization_id, src.account_contact_id, src.first_name, src.last_name, src.full_name, src.contact_email, src.contact_phone, src.company_id, src.company_name, src.location_id, src.owner_user_id, src.owner_name, src.lead_source, src.lead_status, src.disqualify_reason, src.bant_budget, src.bant_authority, src.bant_need, src.bant_timeline, src.converted_deal_id, src.crm_status, src.is_active, src.marketing_opt_out, src.created_at, src.updated_at FROM (
SELECT 
  cp.id,
  cp.organization_id,
  cp.account_contact_id,
  cdp.first_name,
  cdp.last_name,
  cdp.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(cdp.last_name, '') AS full_name,
  id_k.key_value AS contact_email,
  id_p.key_value AS contact_phone,
  cp.company_id,
  c.name AS company_name,
  cp.location_id,
  cp.owner_user_id,
  su.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(su.last_name, '') AS owner_name,
  cp.lead_source,
  cp.lead_status,
  cp.disqualify_reason,
  cp.bant_budget,
  cp.bant_authority,
  cp.bant_need,
  cp.bant_timeline,
  cp.converted_deal_id,
  cp.crm_status,
  (cp.crm_status = 'active') AS is_active,
  cp.marketing_opt_out,
  cp.created_at,
  cp.updated_at
FROM crm.contact_profiles cp
LEFT JOIN cdp.customer_profile cdp ON cdp.cdp_id = cp.account_contact_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ik.key_value 
  FROM cdp.identity_keys ik 
  WHERE ik.cdp_id = cp.account_contact_id AND ik.key_type = 'email' AND ik.organization_id = cp.organization_id 
  ORDER BY ik.created_at ASC 
  LIMIT 1
) id_k ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ik.key_value 
  FROM cdp.identity_keys ik 
  WHERE ik.cdp_id = cp.account_contact_id AND ik.key_type = 'phone' AND ik.organization_id = cp.organization_id 
  ORDER BY ik.created_at ASC 
  LIMIT 1
) id_p ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN crm.companies c ON c.id = cp.company_id AND c.organization_id = cp.organization_id
LEFT JOIN accounts.setup_users su ON su.id = cp.owner_user_id
WHERE cp.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
) src WHERE TRUE
)
SELECT lead_status, CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS contact_count FROM rpt_contacts AS contacts WHERE is_active = TRUE AND TRUE AND TRUE AND TRUE GROUP BY lead_status ORDER BY contact_count DESC LIMIT 500

tasks.sql:
MATCH (u:User)
WHERE ($can_view_all = true OR u.id = $effective_user_id)
  AND (coalesce($rep_name, '') = '' OR toLower(u.first_name) CONTAINS toLower($rep_name) OR toLower(u.last_name) CONTAINS toLower($rep_name))
OPTIONAL MATCH (d:Deal) WHERE d.owner_user_id = u.id
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:HAS]->(q:Quote)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Account {id: d.company_id})
WITH u, d, a, collect(q) AS quotes
WITH u, d, a,
     [q IN quotes WHERE toLower(q.approval_status) = 'approved'][0] AS approved_quote,
     quotes[0] AS any_quote
WITH u, d, a,
     coalesce(approved_quote.currency, any_quote.currency, d.currency, $default_currency, 'INR') AS currency,
     coalesce(approved_quote.total, any_quote.total, d.amount, 0) AS final_amount
WHERE d IS NOT NULL
RETURN u.id AS rep_user_id,
       u.first_name + ' ' + coalesce(u.last_name, '') AS rep_name,
       d.id AS deal_id,
       d.title AS deal_title,
       d.stage AS deal_stage,
       coalesce(a.name, 'Unassigned Account') AS account_name,
       currency,
       final_amount AS deal_value,
       d.lost_reason AS lost_reason,
       d.forecast_category AS forecast_category,
       toString(date(d.created_at)) AS created_date
ORDER BY rep_name, d.created_at
LIMIT 25
